subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After an accepted Gateway run disconnects and recovery cannot establish its terminal result, should `openclaw agent` preserve automatic isolated embedded fallback or fail closed unless the user explicitly opts into rerun?
rationale: Either choice changes existing CLI availability, duplicate-side-effect exposure, delivery behavior, and operator expectations; source review cannot safely choose that user-facing contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Recover first, retain isolated fallback
options.body: Wait and replay the original run first, then preserve the current automatic isolated fallback only when its outcome remains unknowable.

options.title: Recover first, fail closed by default
options.body: Return an explicit unknown-outcome error after recovery exhaustion and require an explicit rerun flag for a fresh embedded execution.

options.title: Split by invocation mode
options.body: Use a mode-specific policy, such as recovery-first for delivery runs and a compatibility fallback for interactive stdout use.

recommendation.title: Recover first, retain isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Wait and replay the original run first, then preserve the current automatic isolated fallback only when its outcome remains unknowable.

likelyOwner.reason: The current fallback containment behavior on main was introduced through their merged change, making them the strongest available history-based routing candidate for the follow-on policy choice.
